hero.name: Luis Aguilar
hero.tagline: I build intelligent products — from SaaS platforms and trading engines to AI workflows and developer tools.

about.title: About me
about.bio: Business Management Engineer with a systems-first mindset. I design and ship products that sit at the intersection of automation, AI, and real business operations. Founder of LEC and CSA. Certified PMI PM aspirant.

contact.title: Let's build something
contact.subtitle: Open to freelance projects, partnerships, and interesting problems.

tier1.lastopp_desc: High-fidelity command center for vehicle auction analysis. Deterministic forensic scoring engine, real-time telemetry, Telegram remote control, and a glassmorphic tactical dashboard.
tier1.fixlab_desc: Multi-tenant SaaS platform for gadget repair shops. Kanban order management, precision inventory, public customer tracking portal, and Supabase-powered real-time updates.
tier1.oip_desc: Decision support system scanning prediction markets and crypto for spread anomalies. Python analytical engines feed a Next.js 15 unified dashboard with the Aether Intelligence design system.
tier1.designstudio_desc: Web platform for independent designers: WCAG contrast checker, palette extractor from images, and an AI strategic workshop powered by Claude. Deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
tier1.lec_desc: Full platform for LEC — a Cambridge English certification consultancy in Mexico. Includes the main marketing site, a multi-tenant SaaS (lecorb), finance module, and Playwright-automated data extraction.

tier2.cvos_desc: AI-powered CV parsing and job-matching pipeline built on n8n + Supabase. Extracts structured data from resumes and surfaces relevant opportunities.
tier2.agents_desc: Multi-agent system that ingests YouTube channels, GitHub repos, and web pages into an Obsidian knowledge base. Built with Streamlit + Python.
tier2.n8n_desc: Internal automation backbone: document conversion, Obsidian KB ingestion with pgvector, and job normalization workflows.
tier2.proxmox_desc: Self-hosted HP Z440 infra running Proxmox VE. Hosts n8n, Chatwoot, and all services via Cloudflare Tunnel. Full audit docs and ops scripts.
tier2.csa_desc: E-commerce brand and business operations for CSA. Includes sprint roadmaps, frontend blueprint, and a documented remediation plan for the web presence.
tier2.scraper_desc: Production-ready Python Playwright scraper with anti-detection, optional proxy rotation, and structured data output for Shopify stores.
